title: Brown-Erdos-Sos Conjecture on Sparse Triple Systems
exact_target: Must every quadratically dense triple system contain any prescribed fixed number of edges supported on at most three more vertices than edges?

sources.citation: David Conlon, Lior Gishboliner, Yevgeny Levanzov and Asaf Shapira, A New Bound for the Brown-Erdos-Sos Problem, author-hosted manuscript.
